text:
Grab's full-time headcount increased from 11,267 employees as of December 31, 2024 to 12,012 employees as of December 31, 2025 — a net increase of 745 employees, or about 6.6% growth [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117].

By function in FY2025 vs FY2024:
- General and administrative: 1,375 vs 1,425 (down 50)
- Sales and marketing: 785 vs 853 (down 68)
- Operations, support and supermarket retail: 6,888 vs 6,055 (up 833)
- Research and development: 2,964 vs 2,934 (up 30)

The growth was driven largely by the "Operations, support and supermarket retail" category, which includes headcount additions from acquisitions such as Everrise (a Malaysian supermarket chain, 865 employees) and Infermove (an AI robotics startup, 22 employees), both acquired during 2025 [Grab, FY2025, p.117]. In addition to full-time staff, Grab also reported 1,242 fixed-term contract employees and 3,956 temporary agency workers as of end-2025, compared with 1,299 fixed-term and 3,795 temporary agency workers at end-2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.117; Grab, FY2024, p.161].
